g.text: E1-E5 indicate event times reported in TMTM Fig. 1 / ST-MTM Fig. 6. Rings indicate nearby scalar minima; named-cyclone identities are unverified.
E1: Anatol | E2: Scandinavia storm | E3: British Isles / Norway storm | E4: Lothar time window | E5: Martin time window
Time axis: frame index. Original spatial data below (same input protocol; full spatial window):
P/R share the complete fixed reference axis. A directional projection does not encode complete 2-D/3-D geometry. No baseline method panels are included.
